messages:
Alex M: Quick heads-up — candidate for SDE role tomorrow 11:00am PT. We still need: room access/hand-off, a debrief scribe, and confirm rubric weighting.
Leila: I can scribe if someone can grab the VC link + room code.
Kevin H: I’ll take room hand-off (building badge). Can someone confirm the rubric split? Are we still doing Design 50 / Code 30 / Communication 20 or did we move to 40/40/20?
Alex M: Good q — last pass said 40/40/20 but some hiring mgrs asked to bump design. For consistency w/ previous rounds let’s keep 40/40/20 unless @Leila objects.
Leila: 40/40/20 is fine. I’ll capture scores in the debrief doc. Share the Notion template?
Alex M: Notion: <https://redwood-internal.notion.so/interviews/debrief-template-xyz> — please use that page and add candidate name + slot.
Marta R: Heads-up I have a conflict at 11:30 PT and might drop off early. If debrief runs long, can we schedule a 10-min quick capture right after for final tally?
Kevin H: Sure. Plan: 40-min interview, 10-min debrief immediately after in the same VC room. If Marta can’t make final tally, I’ll note her quick thumbs.
calendar-bot: Meeting created by Alex M — "SDE interview — final loop" 11:00am PT · Zoom ID 987-654-321
Alex M: Zoom is `https://zoom.us/j/987654321` — room on 5th floor (Conf C). Badge needed after 10:50am.
Leila: Quick rubric clarification: for System Design, are we scoring on architecture correctness + tradeoffs (35) and clarity + prompts (5) — do we separate those or keep as single Design score?
Kevin H: Keep as single Design score but call out subscores in comments. e.g., "Design: 7/10 (architecture 5, tradeoffs 2)" in the doc. That helps calibration.
Alex M: Agree. Tiny ask — when you paste scores, include a one-line rationale (1-2 phrases). Helps hiring manager.
Marta R: If someone could send candidate materials to the room (resume + takehome link), I’ll review quickly before panel.
Alex M: Uploaded to the Notion page. Also copying the take-home URL: `https://files.redwood/candidate/abc123`
Leila: I’ll scribe and paste the scores right after debrief. If anyone wants to grab a screenshot of whiteboard, ping me.
Kevin H: Perfect. Who’s leading the feedback consensus? Alex?
Alex M: I’ll run the debrief and call consensus. If we don’t reach consensus, we’ll mark as "needs follow-up" and schedule a 15-min tie-break with hiring manager.
Marta R: Thanks — I’ll try to stay until 11:40. If I drop, @Kevin H please note my verbal points in the doc under "Marta R — quick notes".
Alex M: Thanks all — final checklist: Kevin (room/badge), Leila (scribe + Notion), Alex (run debrief), Marta (participant, possible early leave). See you tomorrow 10:55am in Conf C or on Zoom. :thumbsup:
Leila: Got it, will be there 10:50 to set up.
Kevin H: I’ll pick up a spare marker & photos for whiteboard.
calendar-bot: Reminder set — 15 minutes before (10:45am).
